entities.summary: James Jeffrey "Jeff" Bradstreet, was an American doctor, alternative medicine practitioner and preacher, who ran the International Child Development Resource Center in Melbourne, Florida, as well as homeopathic medical practices in Buford, Georgia and Arizona. He also founded the Good News Doctor Foundation, which aimed to combine Christian beliefs with medicine. Bradstreet is best known for uncovering claims that vaccines cause autism, as well as various alternative treatments for autism.
